Name: Quality Scrubber
Author: Traktori
Description:
Adds a new machine that can reset the quality of an item. Anything that is either silver, gold or iridium quality gets turned into normal quality items. By default the output is a normal quality version of the input. Some artisan goods have config options for converting them to generic types.

The machine is meant to aide with completing modded community center bundles that require stacks of items of same quality. Also has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿ integration, but you have to be very careful to not wreck your Iridium quality truffle stacks. If you wish to enable it, download both the main file and the optional file named Quality Scrubber Automate Integration.

Here is other mods that achieve similar things as this:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2007]Magic[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3986]Crop Color Combiner[/url]﻿
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*]Install the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿ and their requirements.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use
[/size]You unlock the recipe for the machine at Farming level 2. The recipe is 1 Iron Bar and 1 Refined Quartz. To use the machine you simply click it with the item you wish to reset the quality of, and it takes 30 minutes for it to finish processing.


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Works with Stardew Valley 1.4.5 on Windows, and probably on Linus and Mac too.[/size]
[*][size=2]Probably will not work on android. Most likely has the same interaction issue as my furnace.[/size]
[*][size=2]Should work with all items added through Json Assets, but do report if you find any problems.[/size]
[/list]
